text: The historical port adds run-on-repo-type: [hg] to task defaults and explicitly assigns [hg] in localization and langpack transforms before yielding. Schema acceptance alone does not describe those output writes. Accepted later test defaults include hg and git, while both inspected transforms still assign hg. Preserve these separate scopes and phases; upstream field interpretation, default merging and live task selection were not verified.
title: Repository-type task fields are set in both defaults and generated outputs
